i.norm: escapeCssIdentifier escapes characters that are not valid in a CSS selector. For the input "722m6%0O=.8DAypB": - a leading digit ('7') is escaped as its hex code point: "\37 " (note the trailing space) - the special characters '%', '=', and '.' are backslash-escaped: "\%", "\=", "\." - letters and remaining digits are left unchanged
